title: Items and text display is clipped / wrongly show in diferent monitors resolutions
author: vansanper
body_snippet:
**What happens** (and what you expected instead):
-mRemote displays messages clipped with controls overlaped=> messages showing all the content correctly
-mRemote displays messages windows are fixed with no option to resize to view all the text correctly=> messages resizable by mouse drag on the edges

comments.snippet:
Thank you for the report and the screenshot. It showed exactly what was wrong with the dialog, and we could reproduce that part.

comments.author: vansanper
comments.snippet: Tested in the latest version, it seems to work (screenshot included). The only problem there is the checkbox (left to the text "Do not show this message again") is a little clipped on the bottom.

In our single-monitor lab at 100% scaling the checkbox is complete, and Cancel/Disconnect work; that does not reproduce your display setup.
Please add the exact build from Help → About and the scaling percentage of the monitor showing that dialog; the resolution and RDP context are already in your report.
